svg.title: Utility Pod - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 30, PDF 31. Asymmetric exterior preserves dorsal-plan docking clamp, broad cockpit body and narrowing forward arm block. Thin tow cable omitted. Grapple shortened to legible finger marks; right-facing source rotated up. Illustration corroborates offset clamp.
